name: Changeling
printedArtCredit: Andrew Jones, unnamed Changeling, p. 12 (AJ signature).
sourceDistinctions: Minor Change Shape changes the body, with no changes to clothing or possessions. It uses a full-round action at will and grants +10 circumstance on Disguise checks when used to disguise.
The first printing applies the disguise self size and body-plan limits. The FAQ allows a Warforged appearance within those limits.
The p. 13 Dragonmarks paragraph limits the Changeling to copying a mark’s appearance. It cannot use a mark’s power.
This is the June 2004 playable printing. Later playable editions and earlier or later monster entries have their own profile.
